analysis.title: Top Stories (Jack McKeon, GS Sales/Trading)
key_insights: Japan's largest labor union group is seeking another year of wage increases big enough to anchor pay growth against persistent inflation (WSJ).
The Nikkei reports the BOJ will keep rates unchanged at its meeting next week, consistent with market expectations.
The Philippine central bank raised rates by more than expected, citing inflation control during one of the worst energy crises in decades and looming weather-driven shocks (WSJ).
DeepSeek raised about $15 billion from investors including CATL and Tencent (BBG).
Iran's floating oil storage in Asia was fully depleted by mid-October per Kpler, as a U.S. naval blockade stopped Iran from replacing crude it sells to Chinese refineries (WSJ).
The EU reached a provisional deal to overhaul securitization market rules, intended to free billions of euros to finance defense and climate resilience (BBG).
A federal judge barred DHS from knocking on doors to check immigration status in nine states through election day, saying the practice likely violates the Voting Rights Act (BBG).
A risk-off mood lifted Treasuries, the yen and the Swiss franc. The 30-year US yield touched its lowest since Sept. 23, while French bonds led a slide in European peers (BBG).
Apple shares have become investors' preferred Big Tech hedge against AI volatility because the company largely sits out the infrastructure spending boom (BBG).

Over the past two weeks, hedge funds net sold global Info Tech stocks at the fastest pace in a decade (-3.3 SDs), driven by long and short sales. Net allocation to Global AI stocks is in the 38th percentile and the aggregate long/short ratio is in the 6th percentile vs. the past year (GS Prime Brokerage).
Eurozone auto registrations for September rose 9.3% y/y, up from 4.5% in August.
Today's US data: initial jobless claims (est. 200k, prior 199k), continuing claims (est. 1710k, prior 1710k) and the September Leading Index (est. -0.1%, prior -0.1%).

HSBC initiated coverage on a broad group of US utilities and power producers, with Buy ratings on Ameren, American Electric Power, CenterPoint, Constellation, Entergy, Evergy, FirstEnergy, NiSource, NRG, PG&E, Pinnacle West, PPL, Sempra, Southern, Talen, Vistra and Xcel, and Hold ratings on the rest.
